culprit_citations.quoted_text: Net investment income to average net assets | 9.87 | %

rationale: F16 flagged a distribution-rate versus income-yield heuristic, but the raw filing does not show a data error. The financial highlights disclose net investment income to average net assets of 9.87% for 2025, while distributions declared were $2.39 per share and the distributions table totals $2.3869 per share / $167.321 million. The income statement reports net investment income of $164.075 million and the tax table reports taxable income of $164.258 million, both essentially in line with total distributions. The source therefore supports a normal distribution-income relationship rather than a mis-extracted value.
